questions.question: How relevant did you find your traineeship for your academic programme at UCPH *
questions.answer: It was very useful since the knowledge I gained in the traineeship was something I wouldn't have been able to get through my academic programme

questions.question: Additional comments
questions.answer: I gained a lot of bioinformatics and medical knowledge which I couldn't have gotten during my masters at ku since in the biology programme there were not so many different courses to choose from within a single specialisation

questions.question: How well did the academic level at UCPH coincide with the tasks completed during your traineeship? *
questions.answer: It coincided well, since I had to work on a project independently, which is also something I had already done before during my programme at UCPH

questions.question: Please elaborate *
questions.answer: My master thesis was mainly independent work, while during the Traineeship, I was allowed to ask for help and guidance but mainly had to carry out my project alone

questions.answer: germans are a bit more outgoing or friendly to strangers than Danes

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going on a traineeship to the same city/region? *
questions.answer:
1. Plan and use your weekends to hike/ explore other cities
2. There are lots of concerts in Cologne which is one hour away
3. Connect with as many researchers as possible at your destination. Research is always more successful when shared and communicated about

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future traineeship students? *
questions.answer: This is just a funny anecdote but since RWTH is famous for being an engineering university, sometimes it feels like you are the only woman in town among the young adult age group. However, this looks different in the health related subjects.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your traineeship experience? *
questions.answer: The researchers were all extremely kind and helpful

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the traineeship? *
questions.answer: For me personally, to decide to do a PhD in Denmark instead because I liked it so much at RWTH Uniklinikum that I almost thought about doing a PhD there, too
